title: Legacy Business Insights contracts: All Contracts, upload, processing queue, contract settings and contract tags

prose.label: Upload and queue.
prose.text: {{upload-formats}} {{queue-statuses}} {{queue-download-filter}} {{queue-error-missing-app}} An unmapped application is a Warning in one article and an Error in the other {{divergence:unmapped-application-status}}. {{queue-error-no-metadata}}
Application details and application tags are in [[business-insights.legacy.applications]]; the area hub is [[business-insights.legacy]].

licensing-models.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Uploaded contracts are analyzed for licensing models (per user, per GB of data, feature based, or a combination), contract end and renewal date.

quotes: assists in analyzing the contract for metadata such as the licensing models (i.e., per user, per GB of data, feature based, or an amalgamation of the preceding models), contract end, renewal date, etc.

contract-name-seller.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, On the All Contracts page the Contract Name is auto-generated and Seller Name is the software value added reseller (SVAR), which can equal the Vendor.

quotes: Contract Name: The name of the contract. This is auto-generated by the Business Insights service.
Seller Name: The name of the software value added reseller (SVAR) who sells the SaaS application service.
This field can be the same as the Vendor field if the vendor is directly selling the subscription.

contract-status.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, A contract's Status is Active, Expired or Pending, where Pending means the subscription has not yet started but the contract is established.

quotes: Status: The status of the contract (i.e., Active, Expired, or Pending). Pending status indicates that the subscription has not yet started, but the contract is already established.

contract-file-availability.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, The availability of the contract file on All Contracts depends on the Contract File Deletion settings on the Contract Settings page.

quotes: The availability of the contract file depends on the Contract File Deletion settings on the Contract Settings page.

contract-deadline-fields.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, All Contracts shows Cancel By (deadline for canceling), Renewal and an Opt-Out Date (when you can opt out before auto-renewal takes effect).

quotes: Cancel By: The deadline for canceling the contract.
Opt-Out Date: The date when you can opt out of the contract before auto-renewal takes effect.
Renewal: The renewal date for the contract.

upload-formats.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Contract upload accepts multiple files per attempt in PDF, DOC and XLS formats, and processing takes minutes, hours or days depending on size and number.

quotes: You can upload multiple files in one attempt. The Business Insights service supports PDF, DOC, and XLS files.
Depending on the size and number of files, the data is processed within minutes, hours, or days.

queue-statuses.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, The Processing Queue Processing Status is In Progress, Error (a processing error) or Warning (contract not mapped to an application).

quotes: In Progress: The data is currently being processed from the contract file.
Error: The Business Insights service encountered an error while processing the data in the file.
Warning: The warning status indicates that the contract is not mapped to an application.

queue-download-filter.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Only AI processed contracts are available for download from the Processing Queue, which filters by Status, Date Added, Uploaded By, Vendor or Applications.

quotes: Download the contract file. Only AI processed contracts are available for download.
Filter contracts by Status, Date Added, Uploaded By, Vendor, or Applications.

queue-error-missing-app.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, A queue Error caused by items without a linked application shows missing application linkage in the Application column; link an application from the drop-down or, if it is not listed, submit a Create New Application Request.

quotes: If the error encountered is because the items in the contracts don't have the application linked to it, the Application column in the Contract Information table shows missing application linkage.
Use the drop-down menu to link to the application.
If the application is not listed in the drop-down menu, click Create New Application Request to submit a request to add the application to the list.

queue-error-no-metadata.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, When the service cannot parse any relevant metadata, the Contract Information table shows no data and the fix is to reupload the contract file in the supported format.

quotes: the Business Insights service is unable to parse any relevant metadata from the file, the Contract Information table shows no data.
To resolve the error, reupload the contract file in the supported format.

contract-value-currency.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, In the Contract Details drawer, ACV and TCV are shown in the default currency set on the Contract Settings page.

quotes: Annual Contract Value: The annual contract value (ACV). The value is displayed as the default currency set on the Contract Settings page.
Total Contract Value: The total contract value (TCV). The value is displayed as the default currency set on the Contract Settings page.

contract-retention.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Contract File Deletion deletes contract files permanently after a chosen number of days (for example 7, 14, 30, 60 or 90) counted from either the upload date or the expiration date.

quotes: Select Upload Date (the date when the contract is uploaded) or Expiration Date (the date when the contract expires).
after which the Business Insights service permanently deletes the contract files (e.g., 7, 14, 30, 60, or 90 days).

contract-tag-limits.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Contract tags allow at most 8 tag categories, each with at most 8 tags.

quotes: You can add a maximum of 8 tag categories, and each category can consist of 8 tags.

contract-tag-single.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, When manually tagging contracts, only one tag in a category can be linked to a contract.

quotes: Note that only one tag in a category can be linked to a contract.

contract-tag-criteria.statement: In the legacy Business Insights help, Dynamic contract tag criteria are TCV, ACV, Seller Name, Application, Vendor and License, with operators greater than, greater than or equal to, less than, less than or equal to, equal to, Is, Is not, Contains and Not Contains.

quotes: - TCV - ACV - Seller Name - Application - Vendor - License

Operator: Select an operator to set the threshold to satisfy the criteria as greater than (>), greater than or equal to (>=), less than (<), less than or equal to (<=), equal to (=), Is, Is not, Contains, or Not Contains.

unmapped-application-status.summary: A contract with no application mapped is a Warning in the processing queue statuses and an Error in the queued contracts article.

quotes: Warning: The warning status indicates that the contract is not mapped to an application.

positions.says: A contract that is not mapped to an application has the Warning status.

quotes: If the error encountered is because the items in the contracts don't have the application linked to it, the Application column in the Contract Information table shows missing application linkage.

positions.says: Contract items without a linked application are described as an error.

unmapped-application-status.impact: Whether a contract missing its application mapping shows Warning or Error in the Processing Queue is described differently by the two articles.
